payload.cache_rule: all proposals counted; same two alleles reuse deterministic fitness, reported as cache hits
payload.fitness: all demonstrations reconstructed by either ranked output, task Boolean; no queries
payload.limitations: tiny four-proposal pilot, narrow synthetic curriculum, exposed nativeDEV; no frontier inference
payload.mate_rule: if sampled same hash twice and another contemporary exists, second mate is lowest-hash distinct contemporary
payload.mortality_sharing: same living helper on crossover/mutation; controls do not isolate these mechanisms
payload.random_control: uniform two alleles from shared four-allele bank, no fitness-guided proposal
payload.winner: highest absolute solve count among evaluated archive, hash tie
